# AL-Madenah Real Estate — crawler policy
# Public site: fully crawlable. Admin console: kept out of search results.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/

# The sitemap is generated by the API from the database, so every published listing is in
# it the moment it goes live. Listed by absolute URL because that is what the standard
# requires; crawlers that find this file on any host will follow it to the canonical one.
Sitemap: https://elmadenah.com/sitemap.xml
